title: Mesh Beach Bag
description: A roomy openwork tote for towels, yarn, or light everyday carrying.
expectationText: A larger carry project that focuses on keeping open mesh consistent while still reinforcing the base and handles enough for everyday use.

steps.title: Make the base
steps.instruction: Build a flat oval or rectangle base with a few rounds of firm stitches.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work evenly around the base edge and place a marker at the start of the round.

steps.title: Transition to mesh
steps.instruction: Work one steady round before opening into chain-space mesh.

steps.title: Grow the bag body
steps.instruction: Repeat the mesh pattern until the bag reaches a roomy beach-tote height.

steps.title: Add handles
steps.instruction: Chain handle openings and reinforce them with one or two final rounds.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off carefully and weave in ends where they will not snag.
